content.comment_body: Hello, I need to set an output signal to 'high' whenever a PT100 sensor reads a temperature above 20°C or below 0°C. So far, I've only found ways to compare readings from two PT100 sensors, but I want to compare the sensor reading to a fixed temperature value. How can I configure a static temperature threshold for the comparator? Any guidance would be appreciated.
Hello, Have you tried using the 'Analog threshold trigger' function?
